overview.title: Rhythm That Put Essaouira on the Map
overview.p1: Gnaoua music mixes African, Amazigh and Islamic spiritual currents. Essaouira became a world reference through its festival and a year-round scene of musicians, rituals and fusion projects.
overview.p2: You may hear street performances, booked concerts or festival stages depending on the dates. Approach the tradition with respect — it is not only entertainment.
overview.p3: Ask your riad or the tourist office what is on during your stay. One strong evening of music can define the whole trip.

q1.question: When is the Gnaoua Festival?
q1.answer: Typically early summer — check the official calendar for exact dates.

q2.question: Can I hear Gnaoua outside the festival?
q2.answer: Yes — smaller performances run through the year.

q3.question: Is it only in Essaouira?
q3.answer: The tradition exists elsewhere, but Essaouira is a major stage.

q4.question: Do I need a guide for Gnaoua music?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and local context.

q5.question: Is Gnaoua Heritage suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with normal supervision in crowded venues or evening events.
